argv:
Seat accounting is wrong in two ways:

1. When an admin removes a member from a workspace, the workspace's seat usage (shown on the billing page and used by the plan checks, e.g. when changing plan) does not go down, neither right away nor after the periodic usage recount has run. So a workspace that removed people to fit into a smaller plan still cannot downgrade. Removing a member must free their seat immediately, and the periodic recount must agree: only current, active members occupy seats.
2. Revoking a pending invitation does not give its seat back. A workspace whose seats are all taken by members plus pending invitations still cannot invite anyone after revoking one of those invitations. Re-sending a pending invitation (which replaces it with a fresh one) also fails in a full workspace, because the replaced invitation keeps holding its seat. Only invitations that are still pending (neither accepted nor revoked) may hold a seat. A workspace that really is full must still be refused.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
